goal: Keep the active canvas permanently mounted as the center workspace while preserving collapsible side rails, document tabs and legacy canvas-tab migration.
non_goals: Do not implement note drag references, rich-media ingestion, AI HUD internals, retrieval, credentials, recovery or packaging.
Do not change canvas geometry, collision, relation or persistence semantics.
Do not read, print or modify provider credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Pure layout policy enforces the exact left/right sizes, bounds, narrow-window collapse order and persisted preferences from the Task 7 brief.
page.tsx has one permanent canvas path and no conditional immersive canvas root or right-side Chat panel.
Canvas selection updates activeCanvasId independently from activeTabId; files and records remain document-panel tabs.
Legacy canvas tabs are removed during article-store initialization without losing document tabs or view state.
Panel, tab and HUD changes do not remount the CanvasEditor for the active canvas.
Focused shell tests, relevant Canvas tests, TypeScript and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed and independently reviewed.
notes: Read the Task 7 brief first and use test-first implementation.
CanvasEditor identity must depend on canvas ID only.
The React shell and store callback surfaces are explicit manual context boundaries because their dynamic dispatch edges are pre-existing and broad.
Preserve the existing left-sidebar content and right document editor behavior.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Do not expose or change configured provider secrets.
